title: Unpaid Mini App scope exposes paid modules
original_report: Verify that Elena can use the Telegram Mini App for Vesyolaya Raschyoska while only the Engels location is paid and the remaining scope stays behind payment gates.
discovery_scope: Telegram binding and Mini App bootstrap
Mini App navigation and payment-gate behavior

candidates.candidate: Mini App does not apply the selected location subscription gate
candidates.contract: Only Engels is paid; the web dashboard already gates paid sections for inactive subscriptions.
candidates.trigger: Open the Mini App in the network scope or select the inactive Dolgoozernaya location.

expected: Paid Mini App modules are read-only for the network and Dolgoozernaya, while Engels remains available.
actual: Content, Finance, Operator, Partnerships and Progress were all marked available for the inactive Dolgoozernaya subscription.
environment: Local Python 3 with pytest 9; Vite/Vitest frontend; production Docker Compose and PostgreSQL
reproduction: A focused unit test passes an inactive trial business scope to the real Mini App navigation builder and checks the paid module statuses.
failure_signal: The test listed content, finance, operator, partnerships and progress as exposed.
root_cause: Mini App navigation was derived only from scope kind and feature flags. It never evaluated the selected businesses' subscription tier, status or end date, and the frontend treated read-only navigation entries as openable.
fix_summary: Added server-side subscription evaluation for business and network scopes, converted paid navigation entries to read-only with a billing reason, blocked paid Mini App routes and actions, and added a mobile payment sheet instead of opening locked modules.
why_causal: The subscription decision now directly controls both the navigation status and server route access for the same selected scope.

reproduction_files.summary: Focused red-to-green subscription regression test approved at Gate 1.

fix_files.summary: Scope-aware subscription check and server payment gates.
Mini App payment sheet and guarded navigation.
Routes locked outcome cards to the payment sheet.

checks.name: Production build
checks.detail: Vite build completed with exit code 0.

checks.name: Production scope verification
checks.detail: Engels available; network and Dolgoozernaya read-only for paid modules.

limitations: Elena has not yet consumed her one-time Telegram link, so her real Telegram initData was not used during verification.
residual_risks: The final real-device check can only be completed after Elena opens the personal link in her Telegram account.
notes: The personal binding token was not consumed during testing.
Production app and Telegram Mini App page both returned HTTP 200 after deployment.
